overview.title: Space Weather: The Sun's Influence on Earth and Beyond
overview.description: Solar activity affects technology, astronauts, and life on Earth

classification.m: M-class: medium, can cause brief radio blackouts
classification.x: X-class: major, can cause planet-wide radio blackouts

carrington.effects: Telegraph systems failed, auroras at equator
carrington.today: Would cause $2 trillion damage to modern infrastructure

coronalMassEjections.description: Billion-ton clouds of magnetized plasma ejected from Sun
coronalMassEjections.travelTime: 15-18 hours to 3-4 days to reach Earth
coronalMassEjections.frequency: Several per day during solar maximum

famous.telegraphs: Telegraph operators shocked, paper caught fire

geomagneticStorms.description: Disturbances in Earth's magnetic field from solar wind

effects.g1Minor: Weak power fluctuations, minor satellite impact
effects.g5Extreme: Complete power grid collapse possible, satellites lost

geomagneticStorms.auroras: Major storms bring auroras to mid-latitudes

auroras.cause: Solar particles collide with Earth's atmosphere
auroras.otherPlanets: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune also have auroras

solarWind.description: Stream of charged particles from Sun
solarWind.magnetosphere: Earth's magnetic field deflects solar wind
solarWind.vanAllen: Trapped particles form Van Allen radiation belts
solarWind.heliopause: Boundary where solar wind meets interstellar space (~120 AU)

solarRadiationStorms.description: High-energy particles accelerated by flares and CMEs
solarRadiationStorms.danger: Hazardous to astronauts and aircraft crews

effects.polar Flights: Increased radiation, may need to reroute
effects.biologicalRisk: High dose can cause acute radiation sickness

radioBlackouts.description: Disruption of radio communications from X-ray flares
radioBlackouts.daySide: Only affects day side of Earth (where ionosphere is ionized)

satellites.drag: Atmosphere expands during storms, increases drag

powerGrids.gic: Geomagnetically Induced Currents in long conductors
powerGrids.carrington: Carrington-level event could cause $2 trillion damage

aviation.rerouting: May need to avoid polar routes during storms

spacecraft.iss: Has shielded areas for radiation storms

forecasting.agencies: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center, ESA, others

satellites.stereo: Two spacecraft viewing Sun from different angles

forecasting.watches: Space weather watches and warnings issued

protection.magnetosphere: Earth's magnetic field deflects most solar wind
protection.no Magnetosphere: Mars lost atmosphere without magnetic field

extremeEvents.july2012: Extreme CME missed Earth by 9 days

cosmicRays.description: High-energy particles from outside solar system
cosmicRays.solarMin: Cosmic rays increase when solar activity is low

meteoroids.showers: Annual meteor showers from comet debris

futureThreats.superflare: Stars can produce flares 10,000x stronger than Carrington
futureThreats.ourSun: Could our Sun produce superflare? (Unlikely but possible)
futureThreats.civilization: Modern tech more vulnerable than in 1859
futureThreats.recovery: Could take years to fully recover
